I planned Phase 1 (Rules engine and test hook) as 2 plans in 2 waves. The automatic plan check returned **PASS** with no CAUTION items. Nothing has been built or committed yet.

| Wave | Plan | Persona | What it delivers |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 01-01 | engineering-senior-developer (top ranked, score 13) | `src/engine.js` with all the spec's rules; a baseline `chooseMove` in `src/ai.js` (pure, avoids immediate crashes, under 20 ms); node tests named after each spec rule, plus a randomized stress test |
| 2 | 01-02 | testing-qa-verification-specialist (top ranked, score 8) | `src/game.js` as the shared game controller; a minimal `index.html` and `src/main.js` exposing `window.tron`; node tests for the controller; `tools/verify-hook.cjs`, a Playwright/Chromium check of the hook |

**Pipeline summary (`--auto`)**

| Stage | Status | Key findings |
|---|---|---|
| Board assessment | Ran (3.8/10) | Its red flags only say there is no code or plans yet, which is expected before planning. I adopted its recommendations as constraints: the engine uses no randomness or clock, one test per rule, explicit head-on, swap and "every move is fatal" tests, and a randomized stress test. |
| Domain / spec | Skipped | Not a design or marketing phase, and the spec step was skipped. I also skipped the architecture proposals, which is the default when confirmations are off. |
| Decomposition | Done | 2 plans, 6 tasks; the two waves change no files in common |
| Plan check | PASS | I also checked that every phase requirement is covered and that the verification commands test the success criteria. No changes needed. |
| Design review | Skipped | Not a design phase |
| Security scan | No triggers | No secrets or dependencies. The OWASP code review is left for review time because the files don't exist yet. |

Key decisions made while planning:
- **ES modules:** a dependency-free `package.json` with `"type":"module"` lets node import the same modules the browser uses.
- **Playwright script is CommonJS:** it is a `.cjs` file because Playwright only loads through `require`.
- **One controller:** Phase 2's real-time loop will call the same `step()` that `window.tron` uses.

I took the defaults wherever a confirmation would normally be asked. I kept every recommended persona and did not create a GitHub issue. I also skipped the helper's codebase scan, because the repo only contains the spec so far.

The plans are in `.planning/phases/01-rules-engine-and-test-hook/`.

Next: `/triad:build 1`
